mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that correlate with rising corporate earnings and investor confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it signals persistent economic weakness and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in consumer spending (RSAFS) and inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates strong demand and potential inflationary pressures, triggering monetary policy tightening that reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising CPIAUCSL and RSAFS fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, as indicated by rising FEDFUNDS, the increased cost of capital reduces the present value of future equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods classified as monetary tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates and boosts equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 500.0 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the residential sector, which reduces consumer wealth and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where HOUST < 500.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic expansion, which correlates with rising corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and INDPRO fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, as indicated by high industrial production (INDPRO) relative to historical averages, the economy approaches capacity constraints, leading to inflationary pressures and potential monetary tightening, which reduces S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods classified as late-cycle expansion.
